subject.title: [Bug]: Hundreds of repeated HTTP requests to 169.254.169.254:80 for the first 10 minutes after the startup

question: Is the source-backed no-signal fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90694 sufficient to land, or should this wait for live sandbox plus explicit AWS default-chain proof?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and the linked PR is focused, but the fix sits on an auth-provider/security boundary where source tests cannot fully prove EC2/ECS/profile/SSO behavior.

options.title: Require live credential-mode proof
options.body: Ask for or run one no-signal sandbox trace plus one explicit Bedrock default-chain credential run before closing this issue through the linked PR.

options.title: Accept source-backed proof
options.body: Land the linked PR after exact-head CI if maintainers accept the AWS SDK source contract and contributor live output as enough for this limited fix.

options.title: Keep issue open and revise the fix
options.body: Leave the issue open if maintainers want a different credential-detection policy than the linked PR implements.

recommendation.title: Require live credential-mode proof
recommendation.body: Ask for or run one no-signal sandbox trace plus one explicit Bedrock default-chain credential run before closing this issue through the linked PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is most connected to the current Bedrock memory adapter boundary and the prior plugin refactor that owns this decision surface.
